payload.name: Castle / detailed AI route concept
payload.prompt:
A complete castle complex viewed from a three-quarter angle, standing on a plain neutral studio background. The castle features interconnected fortified walls with crenellated tops, multiple square and cylindrical towers of varying heights, and a central keep with arched windows and a prominent gatehouse. Exterior surfaces are rendered in smooth, painted stone with subtle texture, accented with blue, brown, beige, and gray tones. Wooden shutters, metal gates, and shingled roof sections are visible on towers and annexes. The rendering style is cartoonish 3D with soft lighting, clear outlines, and stylized proportions. rounded turret bases, stone pathways leading to the main gate, small battlements along the walls, arched entryways with wooden doors, and a flagpole atop the central tower. 
create for me 1 castle, style similar to this image ref
Visual style: blue; brown; beige; gray; stone; wood; metal; shingles; smooth and painted surfaces with subtle texture; cartoonish 3D rendering with soft lighting and clear outlines
Exactly ONE connected standalone asset, full silhouette visible, one three-quarter camera view. Plain neutral studio background, generous clear space around all roof tips, side walls and foundation.
Photograph the isolated object against a uniform neutral studio sweep.
Colors: brown, charcoal, gray, ivory.
Visual style: ivory limestone; chestnut oak; midnight blue slate; aged bronze; navy gold cloth; cyan mana; limestone #e4d7b5; oak #69442e; slate #263b59; bronze #99704a; banner #1b315f; mana #55e5ef; orthographic view
Production game-asset beauty render, finely resolved surface relief, readable crafted edges, rich coherent material variation and carefully finished textures. Preserve the requested stylization.
A single standalone 3D game asset, zoomed out, three-quarter view, full object centered with clear margin, plain neutral studio background.
